environment.description: ECS Fargate task in private subnet (no IGW route). Origin is accessible ONLY via CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net) configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy type 'always-sign'. The ALB security group restricts inbound to AWS CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) on port 8080 only. CloudFront distribution has a custom cache behavior requiring signed URLs with RSA-SHA1 key pair (key group kg-9f8e7d6c) — requests without valid Signature, Key-Pair-Id, and non-expired Expires parameters receive 403. CloudFront removes and re-normalizes the X-Amz-Content-Length header via origin request policy (managed policy 'AllViewerExceptHostHeader' does NOT forward X-Amz-* headers to origin). The Fargate task additionally uses platform version 1.4.0 with a custom task definition specifying linuxParameters.capabilities.drop=['ALL'] and a read-only root filesystem.

config.network: private subnet, no IGW, NAT-only egress
config.security_group: inbound restricted to AWS managed prefix list pl-3b927c52 (CloudFront origin-facing IPs) port 8080

cloudfront.cache_behavior: POST allowed but body size limited to 1MB via CloudFront
